title: Senior Shopify Developer
description:
We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here 

🌎 About garden3d 

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

- Lightphone 

- Mill 

- IngredientAI 

🔮 Who we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

- Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.

- Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).

- Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.

- Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.

- Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.

- Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.

- Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.

- Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

🔑 Must-Have Competencies: 

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

- 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.

- Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js .

- Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).

- Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).

- Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.

- Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.

- Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.

- Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies: 

- Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.

- Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.

- Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.

- WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.

- Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).

- Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

💸 Compensation 

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

🎤 How we interview 

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

👩‍🏭 How we work: 

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

- Transparency & Ownership : We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.

- 150% Carbon Negative : Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021. 

- Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).

- Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.

- Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.

- Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here , or our Medium, over there . 

Important Reminders 

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

title: Backend Engineer - Agentic AI (m/w/d)
description:
Overview getpress entwickelt eine eigene KI-Agenten-Plattform (LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Next.js) für die PR-Branche 

Der Servicemarkt, von Legal über Consulting bis hin zu Agenturen, steht vor der größten Transformation der Geschichte. Gleichzeitig wird der milliardenschwere PR-Markt im Zeitalter von AI-Visibility gerade immer wichtiger. getpress, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden PR-Agenturen Deutschlands (>40 Leute, Kund*innen wie Trivago, Komoot, Fonio AI oder AutoScout24), hat sich entschieden, diesen Wandel zu führen statt abzuwarten. Wir bauen die PR Company der Zukunft: keine reine Service-Company mehr, sondern eine Service-as-a-Software-Company. 

Unser AI-Team besteht nun seit 4 Monaten, aktuell ein Developer, eine Produktmanagerin und unsere Head of AI. Die Grundarchitektur steht, erste Teile unserer PR-Plattform und des Multi-Agent-Systems laufen produktiv. Jetzt fehlst du – die Person, die als Backend Engineer das technische Fundament zusammen mit unserem zweiten Developer ownt und gemeinsam neu definiert, wie die PR der Zukunft funktioniert. 

Deine Rolle - PR-Plattform: Fullstack-Entwicklung der Plattform, die das Operating System der PR-Agentur 2027 wird. Nah an den Nutzer*innen, in schnellen Entwicklungszyklen, und wo deine Entscheidungen den Kurs setzen. 

- KI-Agenten: Aufbau eines Agenten-Systems, das die PR-Wertschöpfungskette End-to-End neu definiert. Du baust die Agenten, mit denen unsere Berater*innen täglich arbeiten, inkl. Self-Learning-Loops und Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung. 

- Systemarchitektur: Mitgestalten der Systemarchitektur, inkl. Workflows, Datenmodell, Schnittstellen, Compliance und Tech Stack (bisher vorwiegend PostgreSQL, Next.js, LangGraph, Docker) 

- Datenmanagement: Weiterentwicklung der Datenbank-Architektur inkl. relationaler Daten- und Vektor-Datenbanken 

Wer du bist Must haves: 

- > 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung 

- > 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten und -Komponenten wie Memory, Context-Engineering, Retrieval und Orchestration unter Verwendung von Frameworks wie Langchain, CrewAI, Langgraph o.ä. 

- Tech Stack: TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, LangGraph, Github 

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Systemen mit Frameworks (fastAPI, springboot, nestJS, etc.) und gängigen Programmiersprachen (z.B. Java, Typescript, Python) 

- Erfahrung mit Container-based und Cloud-native Architekturen (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS oder ähnlich) 

- C1-Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, B2-Niveau ist ausreichend (mit Motivation in deinem ersten Arbeitsjahr den Kurs zu C1 zu machen) 

Nice to haves: 

- Datenkompetenz: Sicher in SQL, API Design, Schema-Design, Query Optimization 

- Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI-/ML-Modellen in Produktionssysteme, sowie im Verständnis des Modellverhaltens, der Modellleistung und der Modellbeschränkungen 

- Product-Engineering: Erfahrung darin, Anforderungen aus Business- und Nutzer:innen-Perspektive einzuordnen, bevor sie technisch umgesetzt werden 

- Erfahrung in Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, o.ä.) 

- Erfahrung mit Agentic Development (Claude Code, Codex, o.ä.) 

Was dich erwartet - Architekt des Tech-Layers: Du bist unser technischer Experte und gestaltest mit, wie getpress Technologie denkt und nutzt 

- KI in Anwendung: Du bringst KI an der Vorfront technischer Möglichkeiten in unsere Prozesse und Strategie 

- Autonomie: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Management, setzt eigene Ideen um und definierst Standards, an denen wir uns orientieren 

- Ein echtes Team: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. 

- Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob im Berliner Office oder remote (in DE) – wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wir suchen jemanden mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Das heißt wann und wo (in DE) du deinen Arbeitsalltag gestaltest, entscheidest du selbst. Klare Kommunikation und Vertrauen sind dabei für uns selbstverständlich. 

Wie gehts weiter? Das klingt genau nach dir? 

Dann sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf. 

Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
description:
About Pleo 

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application. 

About the role 

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to 

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

- 
Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

- 
Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

- 
Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

- 
Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

- 
Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

- 
Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

- 
Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

- 
Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

- 
Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- 
Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

- 
A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

- 
Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

- 
Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

- 
Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

- 
Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

- 
AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

- 
Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

- 
The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

- 
Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you 

This role is a good fit for you if:

- 
You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

- 
You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

- 
You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- 
You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

- 
You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

- 
You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role 

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

- 
Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

- 
Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

- 
Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits 

- 
Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- 
Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- 
Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

- 
25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

- 
For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

- 
We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- 
Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process 

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- 
Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- 
Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

- 
Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

- 
Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- 
We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

- 
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- 
This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

About your application 

- 
English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- 
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- 
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- 
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- 
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here .

- 
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- 
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

- 
Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

- 
Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT 

- 
A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

- 
A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

- 
A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
tests, or own your performance regressions.

- 
A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

- 
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl 

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

Benefits 

- 
Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results

- 
24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays

- 
Unlimited sick leave

- 
In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)

- 
4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)

- 
Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years

- 
€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure

- 
€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home

- 
€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences

- 
€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health

- 
Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com 

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build and scale Mattermost's core web platform for teams operating in defense and critical infrastructure sectors. You will contribute across our Go backend and React/TypeScript web frontend, building features that hold up under strict security, compliance, and reliability requirements.

Our engineering culture is AI-forward. We expect engineers to work fluently with AI coding agents such as Claude Code day-to-day — for scaffolding, refactors, code review, and test generation — and treat that as core craft rather than a shortcut. We would rather hire smart people who get stuff done than chase an exact tech-stack match. If you have a track record of shipping and owning complex software end-to-end, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do 

- Architect and build full-stack features optimized for scalability and performance across Go, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Redis

- Leverage AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor as a core part of your daily workflow while retaining full accountability for correctness, security, and design decisions

- Develop internal tooling and testing infrastructure to speed up the team's delivery, including agentic workflows and skills that make AI tooling more effective for the broader team

- Own testing strategy across frontend and backend code you ship

- Design and consume REST and WebSocket APIs with solid networking fundamentals

- Maintain the security and compliance standards required by our government and enterprise clients

- Contribute to Mattermost's open-source codebase

What We Are Looking For 

Required:

- Strong full-stack development experience in Go and React, or a comparable stack

- Experience designing and consuming REST and WebSocket APIs with solid networking fundamentals

- Relational database experience including PostgreSQL, schema design, and query optimization

- Hands-on daily fluency directing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot for scaffolding, refactors, code review, and test generation — with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to take the wheel yourself

- Bias toward shipping and owning complex software end-to-end without close supervision

Nice to Have:

- Experience with distributed systems or high-availability service architecture

- Familiarity with enterprise or regulated-environment security requirements

- Background in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure products

- Open-source contributions

- Experience working on distributed or remote-first teams

- Experience building tools, skills, or workflows on top of AI coding agents including MCP servers, agent skills, or CI-integrated agents

How Success Is Measured 

- First 90 Days: Shipping full-stack features on the core platform using an AI-forward agentic development workflow and owning testing strategy across the code you ship.

Why Mattermost 

- Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide

- Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership

- AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty

- End-to-end ownership: Ship and own complex software across the full stack with real accountability for what you build

- Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant developer community shaping the future of secure collaboration

Compensation 

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Target Salary Range: CAD $162,591–$195,000

Canada Eligibility & Compliance 

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada without current or future sponsorship.

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a government security clearance or equivalent designation (such as Reliability Status or Secret clearance under Canada's Controlled Goods Program), depending on customer engagement. Candidates must meet eligibility requirements to be considered. 

Given Mattermost's work with U.S. defense and government customers, some positions may also require compliance with U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR, which can apply to non-U.S. based employees working on covered technical data. For more information, visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. 

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Frontend)
description:
About Us 

At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world's most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time, and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal, and more engaging.

We're backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.

The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.

The Role 

This role reports to our Head of B2B Product, James. Working with him and our product, design, mobile, and machine-learning teams, you'll design and build the web experiences that redefine how brands and retailers serve their shoppers.

You'll be a full-stack engineer with a frontend centre of gravity, going as far down the stack as each feature needs. You'll turn ambitious and sometimes ambiguous product ideas into software that retailers and brand partners rely on to create, launch, and measure their in-store activity.

You'll be shaping the interfaces that our B2B customers use every day, making the calls on how complex, intelligent capabilities get expressed through interfaces that non-technical users can pick up and trust.

We're agentic-first. Every engineer has access to frontier AI tooling and our own coding harness, and we expect you to use them to move faster, attempt more ambitious work, and stay fully accountable for what you ship.

What You'll Own 

- Full-stack delivery end-to-end. Own substantial features from product conversation through design, implementation, and iteration in production. Most of the weight sits in the frontend, but you go as far down the stack as the feature needs.

- Reactive web interfaces. Design and build the responsive, real-time interfaces that let brands and retailers manage and analyse the in-store experience our product delivers.

- Translating complexity into simplicity. Turn user and business needs into interfaces that make complex, intelligent capabilities feel elegantly simple to non-technical audiences.

- Product partnership. Work in a cross-functional team alongside our Head of B2B Product, prototyping and validating ideas quickly, then shipping the ones that hold up.

- API and system contribution. Contribute to API design, system design, and documentation as part of end-to-end delivery, not as an afterthought.

- Production quality. Own testing, observability, and post-release investigation for the interfaces you ship.

About You 

Must Have 

- Frontend depth. Expert proficiency in TypeScript and React, with a portfolio of production web applications you've owned end-to-end.

- UX and design sensibility. Strong understanding of UX principles and web design fundamentals. You care about interfaces that feel considered, not merely functional.

- Real-time and reactive patterns. Experience with real-time and bi-directional communication protocols (WebSockets, SSE) and managing complex asynchronous state.

- Full-stack capability. Comfortable going down the stack when features call for it, and confident contributing to API and system design conversations.

- Cloud deployment. You've built and deployed services on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

- Product mindset. You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership for what your team puts in front of them, not just the part you wrote.

- Shipping at pace. Evidence that you can move complex, customer-facing products into production quickly, making pragmatic decisions without letting perfection become a blocker.

- AI-native engineering. You've shipped production code with frontier AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and push further into agentic workflows rather than push back on them.

Nice to Have (or We Can Teach) 

- Backend and event-driven experience. Comfort with backend development and event-driven architecture. Our stack includes Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Kafka, and MQTT.

- IoT or edge architectures. Experience working with IoT, edge computing, or hardware-adjacent systems.

- B2B or enterprise product experience. Background building for business or enterprise customers, where reliability, integrations, and data pipelines matter as much as the interface.

- Retail or personalisation. Familiarity with retail technology, commerce platforms, inventory systems, loyalty programs, or customer personalisation.

- Startup experience. Background working at an early-stage startup.

How We Work 

We're a startup, so this is a high-intensity environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and love building. If you're happiest when you're creating, experimenting, and moving fast, you'll love it here.

We draw our energy from being together, so this is an office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from building together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it's easy to get to and a great place to build.

What We Offer 

- Direct access to our founders and a real voice in decisions that shape the product and company.

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

- 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.

- A central London office.

- Team offsites.

- Cycle-to-work scheme.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
description:
Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona

URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ 

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.

We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.

This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. 

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. 

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

- Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles

- Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering

- Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management

- Job and project tracking

- Client and vendor dashboards

- Online payments and transaction tracking

- Reviews and ratings

- Notifications and communications

- Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities

- Admin tools for managing the platform

- Reporting and analytics

- Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. 

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

- Full-stack web development

- Mobile or cross-platform app development

- Strong front-end and back-end development

- Multi-user marketplace platforms

- User authentication and account management

- Payment gateway integrations

- Databases and APIs

- Third-party integrations

- Dashboards and reporting

- Secure, scalable application architecture

- Cloud hosting and deployment

- Testing, maintenance, and optimization

- Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications

If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it.

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.

Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.

This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.

Interested? Tell Us About Yourself

Please send us:

- A quick introduction

- Your resume or LinkedIn profile

- Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built

- Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on

- What you personally worked on for those projects

- Your experience using AI in development

- What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why

- Your availability

A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.

Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. 

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. 

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. 

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. 

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. 

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams. 

As a Staff Engineer , you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps. 

Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Using NodeJS and Typescript back-end stacks, appropriate for each requirement, but always hosted on AWS , we build added value and resilient services on top of voice and fully integrate with our customers’ business critical tools (CRM, Helpdesk, E-Commerce, …). 

Your mission @ Aircall: 

- Lead transversal, complex projects, fully autonomously from ideation to completion, starting from a high-level problem statement.

- Proactively communicate the technical vision across multiple teams, ensuring alignment and sharing knowledge across domains.

- Act as a go-to expert, providing mentorship and guidance across teams.

- Deeply understand multiple product domains; proactively identify improvements and advocate for customer needs across the company.

- Lead and define technical strategies for complex, impactful problems.

- Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.

- Writes production-ready code, finding appropriate solutions for medium complexity challenges; participates in software design discussions; demonstrates a good understanding of system infrastructure and DevOps principles; contributes to performance and quality within their scope; applies a security-first mindset.

A little about you: 

- A little about you:You have extensive experience (e.g., 10+ years) in back-end development, using TypeScript & NodeJS/Python/Ruby/Rails or other languages, with a focus on delivering for security, scalability, availability, and performance across multiple domains.

- You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems.

- You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains , driving initiatives from ideation to completion.

- You are an expert at identifying opportunities for new impactful initiatives.

- You have a deep understanding of multiple product domains and can anticipate long-term needs.

- You possess effective and proactive communication skills, and can collaborate with different profiles and roles to ensure cross-domain alignment.

Our Tech Stack: 

- You do not need to be familiar with all of our technical stack or any specific functional area, but you have a strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly.

- Typescript/Node.js, Python, REST API/GraphQL APIs, Ruby/Rails, React AWS/Serverless or EKS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis

Why join us? 

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

DE&I Statement: 

At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. - Agentic workflows: Turn what was said in a meeting into what gets done. Build the tools and context that let Granola’s agents pick up where the conversation left off.

- Team workspaces. Help companies build a shared context layer from their most important conversations, while still prioritising user privacy and ownership.

- New surfaces. Bring Granola to more of the places people work, across desktop, mobile and integrations.

How we work 

- People and product first. We hire people who are kind, down to earth and pragmatic, who care deeply about the product, and who want to stay connected to the customers using it. Product isn't one team's job here; it's everyone's.

- High autonomy. Engineers spot opportunities and ship improvements themselves. We’d rather you ship it than write about it.

- Everyone talks to users. Every engineer works directly with the people using Granola, and that's where most of our best ideas come from.

- A high bar for engineering and product. We expect strong technical ability and strong product sense. Engineers think like PMs: they understand the user's problem and help shape the direction of what they build.

- Room to experiment. Every engineer has a budget from day one to use new models, tools and technologies which make them more productive.

- Design and quality matter. Thoughtful design, a high quality bar and close collaboration on everything we build.

- We work in person, with flexibility. We’re in the office five days a week because we genuinely like building together. It’s relaxed: dress down, bring your dog, and no fixed office hours.

What that looks like in practice: the version of Granola we use internally goes far beyond the public app. We're building at the frontier of agentic software, and we try every new capability on ourselves first.

The team 

The Granola team is kind, curious and design-obsessed. Many of us are former founders, others have built products at Figma, Apple, Google and Meta, and we're all still learning from each other.

Who we're looking for 

We don't set a minimum number of years. Some of our strongest engineers graduated two years ago; others have run their own companies. We care about what you've built and how you think about it.

- You've shipped user-facing features end to end, with visible impact on a product, and you can show us.

- You're strong in TypeScript, React and Node.js, and comfortable down to Postgres and AWS.

- You have taste: you care about UX, speed and polish, and you push back when something doesn't feel right.

- You're comfortable shaping the problem, not just building the solution, and you enjoy talking to users to get there.

Our stack 

TypeScript, React, Node.js, Postgres, AWS and Terraform, plus whichever new models and tools prove themselves. You don't need experience with everything, but you should be excited to work close to users and ship often.

How we hire 

Our interviews start with the product: who the user is, what problem matters and what you'd build first. Throughout, we're looking for product sense, good judgement on trade-offs, real engineering depth, and how you'd use your experience to shape a product from the ground up. We also look for people who ship quickly, iterate and love to experiment, and who stay kind and pragmatic along the way.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

First-Principles Thinking

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com 

We are seeking a Senior Mobile Engineer to take ownership of the Mattermost mobile experience for teams working in defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure. Our users operate in DDIL environments where connectivity may be disconnected, denied, intermittent, or limited, security is non-negotiable, and the software they depend on has to keep working.

Our mobile app is primarily React Native and TypeScript today, with native iOS and Android integrations. Your immediate focus will be making that experience more reliable and performant. Over time, you'll also help shape the next generation of our cross-platform mobile architecture.

You'll work hands-on across application and native layers, partner closely with platform and feature teams, work directly with customer-facing teams on field reports from constrained environments, and help raise the bar for how we observe, diagnose, and build mobile software.

Responsibilities

Reliability and Performance 

- Architect the app for DDIL and other constrained network environments

- Improve data and functional reliability across connection lifecycle, synchronization, recovery, and failure scenarios

- Own crash-free and release-health outcomes, using telemetry to proactively identify regressions and drive them through diagnosis to resolution

- Profile and improve performance across startup, networking, storage, rendering, memory, and battery usage

Mobile Platform Ownership 

- Own critical iOS and Android integrations and the boundaries between native and cross-platform code

- Maintain and evolve platform capabilities including push notifications, background execution, secure storage, app lifecycle, and real-time communications

- Build within mobile distribution and device-management constraints, including App Store, enterprise and MDM deployment, AppConfig, and Intune MAM

- Diagnose production issues from native traces, telemetry, device profiling, and sparse field logs

- Make architecture recommendations that balance near-term delivery with the long-term direction of the mobile platform

Craft and Delivery 

- Mentor engineers on mobile architecture, reliability, performance, and platform best practices

- Uphold security and compliance standards required by government and enterprise customers

- Contribute to the open-source codebase

- Use AI coding tools effectively, applying strong engineering judgment to increase output without compromising reliability or quality

What We Are Looking For

We care about what you've built and the problems you've solved — not how long you've been building. If you have strong outcomes to speak to in mobile engineering, we want to hear from you.

Required: 

- Deep expertise in iOS or Android development, with strong working knowledge of the other platform

- Strong understanding of mobile architecture, platform SDKs, lifecycle constraints, and networking fundamentals

- Experience building reliable mobile systems that behave predictably through unreliable connectivity, local state changes, synchronization, and recovery

- Strong mobile performance profiling and production debugging skills on real devices

- Experience using production data, crash metrics, and release-health signals to drive reliability improvements

- Experience making architecture recommendations and owning technical outcomes

- Ability and willingness to work across native and cross-platform codebases

- AI fluency and experience using coding agents to increase engineering output while applying judgment to ensure reliable outcomes

Preferred: 

- Experience with React Native and TypeScript

- Experience with mobile persistence, synchronization, or offline-capable systems

- Experience with real-time communications or platform media frameworks such as WebRTC, CallKit, or Android audio APIs

- Experience with enterprise mobile distribution, MDM, AppConfig, or Intune MAM

- Experience building mobile software for security-sensitive, regulated, or operationally constrained environments

- Open-source contributions

Why Mattermost

- Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide

- Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership

- AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty

- End-to-end ownership: Ship and own complex software across the full stack with real accountability for what you build

- Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant developer community shaping the future of secure collaboration

Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Target Salary Range: $165,000 – $215,000 

U.S. Eligibility & Compliance

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government security clearance. Candidates must meet federal eligibility requirements to be considered.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR. For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls .

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer

We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

- Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

- Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

- Application Information:

- Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

- This posting is for a new position.

As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

- Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

- Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

- Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

- Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

- Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

- Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About you 

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

- Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. 

- Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

- Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

- Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

- Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.

- Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

- Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

- Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

- Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana

- Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

- Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

You Are:

- Collaborative : You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.

- Strategic thinker : You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.

- Comfortable with ambiguity : You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

Our Core Behaviors: 

- Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

- Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

- Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

- Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits 

- Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

- Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

- Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

- Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

- Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

- Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 

- Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

- Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment. 

Remote, together 

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected 

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog , LinkedIn , X (Twitter) , and/or Glassdoor . 

Please note: 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered. 

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment. 

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes. 

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice .
